slides.title: Your customers exist. Your shop can't reach them.
slides.sub: Case 03: Opening a premium sportscar brand's shop to markets without guaranteed delivery.

paras: Customers in African countries like Zimbabwe had no access to the online shop. Delivery was never guaranteed.
So they went to the dealership and lived with whatever it had in stock.
slides.title: Why couldn't they just order online?
Build logistics, or use them?
slides.before: New delivery infrastructure for every single market.
slides.after: Mail forwarding services carry the order to the customer.
slides.punch: Use what already works. Remove the blocker.

slides.caption: countries, minimal infrastructure effort
slides.lesson: Access was the real product, not the shop.
slides.sign: I design products that cannot afford to fail.
